abort.already_configured: Already configured. Only a single Zone Heating hub is allowed.

init.title: Global heating settings
init.description: Home presence, debounce delays, dead-man's-switch and overlay termination.

data_description.home_presence_entity: Entity that signals someone is home; drives Away for the whole house. Leave empty to keep the house always 'home' so Away never triggers.
data_description.home_presence_template: Template alternative to the home presence entity; it must render a truthy value while someone is home.
data_description.home_on_delay: Minutes a home-present signal must persist before the house counts as occupied.
data_description.home_off_delay: Minutes the house keeps counting as occupied after everyone has left.
data_description.dead_mans_switch: When on, Home Assistant re-asserts its overlays on a heartbeat so a crashed HA lets the thermostat fall back to its own schedule.
data_description.overlay_termination: How a Home Assistant overlay ends: at the next schedule block, or after a fixed timer.
data_description.overlay_timer_duration: Timer length used when overlay termination is set to 'Fixed timer'.

user.title: Add heating zone
user.description: A zone groups one or more target climate entities and drives them together.

data_description.name: Display name for the zone; becomes the device and the climate entity name.
data_description.targets: One or more climate entities this zone drives together. For a Tado room, pick the room thermostat; it cascades to its TRVs.
data_description.presence_entity: Entity whose state signals that someone is in this zone (person, motion, device tracker, …).
data_description.presence_template: Template alternative to the presence entity; it must render a truthy value when the zone is occupied.
data_description.on_delay: Minutes a presence signal must persist before the zone counts as occupied.
data_description.off_delay: Minutes the zone keeps counting as occupied after presence drops, to avoid flapping.
data_description.window_sensor: Binary sensor that reports an open window or door for this zone.
data_description.window_open_delay: Minutes an open window must persist before heating is cut. 0 reacts immediately (safety).
data_description.window_close_delay: Minutes to wait after the window closes before the zone resumes its mode.
data_description.schedule_switch: The tado_hijack schedule switch for this zone. Leave empty to derive it from the matching schedule switch of the first target. You create the schedule helpers yourself.
data_description.standby_schedule: Optional schedule helper that varies the standby temperature per time block; create it yourself under Settings → Devices & Services → Helpers.
data_description.active_schedule: Optional schedule helper that varies the active temperature per block and gates when Active is allowed.
data_description.off_baseline_temp: Frost-protection setpoint written to the thermostat while the master mode is Off.
